prompt: ok so i've done like 15 cambridge listening practice tests and my score is STILL stuck around band 6.5, i dont get it, what am i doing wrong

assertions.text: Does NOT respond with only generic 'practice more' / 'do more tests' advice
Introduces a diagnostic framework for categorizing WHY answers are wrong (e.g. spelling / specific question-type weakness / focus lapse / vocabulary gap), not just a score
References checking wrong answers honestly against an answer key / audio script as a concrete step
Gives at least one specific, concrete, actionable next step tailored to a stuck-score diagnosis (not vague encouragement like 'keep practicing and you'll improve')
Does not claim to know exactly why this specific user is stuck without first gathering more diagnostic information (asks a clarifying question or explicitly frames next steps conditionally)
